title: ClassDiagram
description: The class diagram body: its orientation, the classes, the relationships between them, the namespaces that group them, free notes, and style classes. A sibling of the flowchart body in this folder; it reuses the same structural principles (self-contained $defs, readable enums, a recursive grouping container, and diagram-global style classes).
$comment: Deferred, to revisit: inline per-node `style` string — held pending a simple representation; class binding via `classes` is the current path. Interaction — `click`/`callback`/`link` with tooltip/href — not yet modeled. (Mirrors the flowchart body's deferrals.)

namespaces.description: The namespaces that group classes. Recursive — a namespace can contain nested namespaces.

notes.description: Free notes on the diagram, each general or attached to a class.

classDefs.description: The diagram's style classes. Declared at the top level because classDef is diagram-global: a class binds by name to any class node from anywhere in the diagram.

orientation.description: The orientation of the diagram (the Mermaid `direction` statement). `TB` top to bottom; `TD` top-down (same as top to bottom); `BT` bottom to top; `RL` right to left; `LR` left to right.

visibility.description: The visibility (encapsulation) of a class member. `public` (Mermaid `+`); `private` (`-`); `protected` (`#`); `package` (package/internal, `~`).

relationshipMarker.description: The marker drawn at one end of a relationship. Its UML meaning is the marker shape together with the line style (see `relationship`). `triangle` inheritance/realization head (`|>`); `filledDiamond` composition (`*`); `hollowDiamond` aggregation (`o`); `arrow` association/dependency head (`>`); `lollipop` interface (`()`); `none` a plain link end.

attribute.description: A class attribute (a member without parentheses). Rendered in the middle compartment.

type.description: The attribute's data type. May carry a generic, written with tildes, e.g. `List~int~`.

static.description: Whether the attribute is static (the Mermaid `$` classifier).

method.description: A class method or function (a member with parentheses). Rendered in the bottom compartment.

name.description: The method name, without the parentheses.

parameters.description: The raw parameter list as written between the parentheses, e.g. `amount` or `List~int~ points`. Empty or omitted means no parameters.

returnType.description: The returned data type, if any. May carry a generic written with tildes, e.g. `List~int~`.

classifier.description: An optional method classifier. `abstract` (the Mermaid `*` suffix); `static` (the `$` suffix).

class.description: A class node: its name, optional annotation and generic, and its attributes and methods.

id.description: The class name, used to reference it from relationships, notes, and namespaces. Composed of alphanumerics (including unicode), underscores, and dashes.

label.description: An optional display label shown instead of the id (the Mermaid `class X["label"]` form). Lets the rendered name carry characters the id cannot.

annotation.description: An optional annotation describing the class's nature, written inside `<<>>` in Mermaid, e.g. `interface`, `abstract`, `service`, `enumeration`. Left open: the set of annotations is not fixed.

generic.description: An optional class-level generic type parameter, written with tildes in Mermaid, e.g. the `Shape` in `Square~Shape~`. The generic is not part of the class id used for references.

classes.description: Names of classDefs applied to this class node (Mermaid `cssClass`/`:::`). Each entry must match a classDefs[].name.

relationship.description: A relationship (edge) between two classes. One decomposed model expresses every case: the eight standard UML relations, two-way relations, and lollipop interfaces. Standard-relation presets a serializer recognizes: inheritance = line solid + toMarker triangle; realization = line dashed + toMarker triangle; composition = solid + filledDiamond; aggregation = solid + hollowDiamond; association = solid + arrow; dependency = dashed + arrow; solid link = solid + none/none; dashed link = dashed + none/none. A two-way relation sets both markers; a lollipop interface sets a lollipop marker at one end.

from.description: The id of the class the relationship starts from.

to.description: The id of the class the relationship points to.

line.description: The line style. `solid` (Mermaid `--`); `dashed` (`..`). Distinguishes inheritance from realization and association from dependency.

label.description: Optional text describing the relationship, rendered on the edge.

cardinalityFrom.description: Optional multiplicity near the `from` end, e.g. `1`, `0..1`, `1..*`, `*`, `n`.

cardinalityTo.description: Optional multiplicity near the `to` end, e.g. `1`, `0..1`, `1..*`, `*`, `n`.

namespace.description: A namespace that groups classes. Recursive — a namespace can contain nested namespaces.

name.description: The namespace name, used internally for nesting and references. Dot notation (e.g. `Company.Engineering`) denotes a hierarchy.

label.description: An optional display label shown instead of the name (the Mermaid `namespace X["label"]` form, v11.15.0+).

classes.description: The classes that belong directly to this namespace.

namespaces.description: Nested namespaces, each a namespace in its own right.

note.description: A note on the diagram (Mermaid `note` / `note for <class>`).

text.description: The note text. Newlines are written with `\n` and carried as a raw string.

forClass.description: The id of the class this note is attached to. Omitted means a general note not tied to a class.

classDef.description: A named style class (Mermaid `classDef name style`), bound to class nodes by name through their `classes` field.

name.description: The class name referenced by a class node's `classes` entry. The reserved name `default` applies to every node without an explicit class.

style.description: The style declarations, comma-separated as Mermaid writes them, e.g. `fill:#f9f,stroke:#333,stroke-width:4px`.
